svc_hero_h1: The electrical work we take on

services.title: Panels and service upgrades
services.body: Old fuses and undersized panels come out and a panel built for the load the space actually draws goes in.
services.evidence: Lighting control panel with labeled circuits installed on the wall

services.title: EV charger installation
services.body: A dedicated circuit is run and the charger is mounted exactly where it needs to be for the vehicle it serves.
services.evidence: Emporia EV charger installed on the exterior wall

services.title: Lighting installation
services.body: Fixtures are wired, mounted and trimmed so the room or the yard reads finished, not just wired.
services.evidence: Interior hallway with a ladder set up for lighting work

services.title: Conduit, meters and exterior work
services.body: Conduit, meters and disconnects are run and fastened outside the same way they are inside, sealed against the weather.
services.evidence: Neatly routed conduit along the interior wall corner

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: jamie seger
reviews.text: Tyler with Rodeo Electric was very professional. He did great work and was very fairly priced. When I have electrical needs done again, he will be the first person that I call.

reviews.author: Tonya Farlow Bennett
reviews.text: Tyler @Rodeo Electric is an exceptional Electrician! We had a pretty major electrical issue at our home late at night & not only did Tyler insist on coming over immediately to ensure our safety, he was able to diagnose the issue quickly.

reviews.author: Gary Rodis
reviews.text: We found Rodeo Electric and decided to use them our first time to install our Tesla home charger. Tyler was punctual, professional and courteous. He came prepared with everything to get the job done. We were extremely happy with his service.

reviews.author: deb dean
reviews.text: Rodeo Electric does a great job. Excellent communication throughout the project. 5 star quality work. I will definitely use Rodeo Electric again.

reviews.author: Ang Sue
reviews.text: Tyler was great! Helpful to explain the process and his thoughts. Very responsive, timely and cleaned up after the job! I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Doerr
reviews.text: Used rodeo electric on several of my jobs now and they are great. Very dependable, reasonably priced and does very good work. I will be using them again for sure.

reviews.author: Keith Dunn
reviews.text: Great experience. He showed up on time, fixed a bad switch quickly, and installed some outdoor lights for us. The work was done neatly and everything works perfectly. Very professional and I'd definitely recommend him.
